title: What is an Assistant Psychologist and what do they do?

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你的专业知识即使在你没工作的时候也能为你赚钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and since 2019 I've been building additional income streams
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在建立额外的收入来源，

sentences.en: through books, online courses, and memberships, and it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 通过书籍、在线课程和会员制，这对我的事业和生活产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7pm, Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you can turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚 7 点，Sophie Foote 将举办一场免费的“在线赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士能加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也会参加，支持一个由心理学家同行组成的可爱社区，探索一对一工作之外的可能性。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，可以观看回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place, because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom too.
sentences.zh: 点击此片头广告中的链接，或在社交媒体上联系我以获取免费名额，因为你既可以服务他人，也理应获得财务自由。

sentences.en: What is an assistant psychologist?
sentences.zh: 什么是助理心理学家？

sentences.en: What do they do and how should they be protected?
sentences.zh: 他们做什么，又该如何受到保护？

sentences.en: With my guest, I am answering all of these questions and more for this really brilliant and insightful podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 在这一期非常精彩且富有洞察力的播客中，我将与我的嘉宾一起回答所有这些问题以及更多内容。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, as I have spoken about before, my route into professional psychology was via a series of assistant psychologist roles.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，我进入专业心理学领域的途径是一系列助理心理学家的职位。

sentences.en: But that is by no means the only way into professional psychology.
sentences.zh: 但这绝不是进入专业心理学领域的唯一途径。

sentences.en: However, it is still a really common one.
sentences.zh: 不过，这仍然是一个非常普遍的途径。

sentences.en: So as part of this series looking at assistant psychologists, I am bringing you a really brilliant, insightful, thoughtful, compassionate chat
sentences.zh: 因此，作为关注助理心理学家系列节目的一部分，我为你带来了一场非常精彩、深刻、体贴且富有同情心的谈话，

sentences.en: with my expert for today, Luke Meakin, who is himself an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嘉宾是今天的专家 Luke Meakin，他本人就是一名助理心理学家。

sentences.en: He is also an older applicant, and so there are so many interesting areas for discussion.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位年龄较大的申请者，所以有很多有趣的领域值得讨论。

sentences.en: If you value this episode, please do take a moment to like, subscribe, follow, comment if watching on YouTube or Spotify,
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这一集有价值，请花点时间点赞、订阅、关注，如果在 YouTube 或 Spotify 上观看请发表评论，

sentences.en: or just get in contact with me on socials or in my free Facebook group, the Aspiring Psychologist community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 或者直接在社交媒体上或我的免费 Facebook 群组“与 Marianne Trent 博士一起的‘有抱负的心理学家’社区”中与我联系。

sentences.en: Hope you find it as interesting, as thought-provoking as I did.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它和我一样有趣且发人深省。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 期待在节目之后与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Luke Meakin, who's an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾 Luke Meakin，他是一名助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Welcome to the podcast, Luke.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到播客，Luke。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是 Marianne。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Oh, well, thank you for being so curious, really.
sentences.zh: 哦，说真的，谢谢你这么好奇。

sentences.en: You know, so we got connected on LinkedIn,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在 LinkedIn 上建立了联系，

sentences.en: exchanged some kind of voice notes and messages, and we're just thinking about, you know, what an assistant psychologist is, what are the responsibilities,
sentences.zh: 交换了一些语音笔记和信息，我们只是在思考，你知道，什么是助理心理学家，职责是什么，

sentences.en: and we thought it might make a really interesting podcast episode, and certainly in preparation for this episode,
sentences.zh: 我们认为这可能会成为一期非常有趣的播客，当然在准备这一集时，

sentences.en: which I will hands up say I haven't had time to do full justice to, which is probably part of the problem, isn't it, for the stuff we're going to talk about.
sentences.zh: 我举手承认我没有时间完全做到尽善尽美，这可能就是问题的一部分，不是吗，对于我们要谈论的事情。

sentences.en: But I've just found it a really interesting process.
sentences.zh: 但我发现这是一个非常有趣的过程。

sentences.en: So thanks for kick-starting more of my thinking in this area already.
sentences.zh: 所以感谢你已经激发了我在这个领域更多的思考。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 是的，没关系。

sentences.en: It's good to have someone else to riff off, because I myself spend a lot of time wondering what an assistant psychologist does and is,
sentences.zh: 有其他人可以交流是很好的，因为我自己也花了很多时间思考助理心理学家是做什么的以及是什么，

sentences.en: even though I've been in it for two years now.
sentences.zh: 尽管我已经在这个岗位上工作了两年了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and having been an assistant, I found it really interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，作为一名助理，我发现这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: So we're kind of referring within today to the guidance put together by the Association for Clinical Psychologists, and in case anyone hasn't heard of them before,
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天在某种程度上参考了临床心理学家协会制定的指导方针，以防有人以前没听说过他们，

sentences.en: they are not our professional body as clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 他们不是我们临床心理学家的专业机构。

sentences.en: You can join it as a qualified clinical psychologist or as a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以以合格的临床心理学家或临床心理学实习生的身份加入。

sentences.en: I think it would be really lovely if they thought about opening that up to people in earlier stages of their career, but it isn't currently.
sentences.zh: 我想如果他们考虑向职业生涯早期的人开放，那会非常棒，但目前还没有。

sentences.en: So in the UK, our professional body for clinical psychology is the Healthcare Professions Council, HCPC, and that's who we pay our registration to.
sentences.zh: 所以在英国，我们的临床心理学专业机构是健康与护理专业委员会 (HCPC)，我们向他们支付注册费。

sentences.en: And again, you can't join as an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 同样，你不能以助理心理学家的身份加入。

sentences.en: It's only for practitioner psychologists, of which there are currently nine in the UK,
sentences.zh: 它只针对执业心理学家，目前英国有九种，

sentences.en: I think I'm right in saying.
sentences.zh: 我想我没说错。

sentences.en: So yes, in case you've landed on this podcast and you're like, what is this?
sentences.zh: 所以是的，以防你偶然发现了这个播客，心想，这是什么？

sentences.en: You know, what is an assistant psychologist?
sentences.zh: 你知道，什么是助理心理学家？

sentences.en: What's your understanding of what an assistant psychologist is, Luke, if that's not too big a question to dump on you?
sentences.zh: Luke，你对助理心理学家的理解是什么，如果这个问题对你来说不是太大的话？

sentences.en: I suppose it can be quite broad.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能相当广泛。

sentences.en: My big issue is the ambiguity of the role.
sentences.zh: 我的大问题是这个角色的模糊性。

sentences.en: I think that's why I reached out to you.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我联系你的原因。

sentences.en: However, my understanding, I suppose, would begin with the work that the psychologist, the qualified psychologist can give up and give someone else.
sentences.zh: 然而，我的理解，我想，会从合格的心理学家可以放弃并交给别人的工作开始。

sentences.en: And, you know, for want of a better term, potentially the grunt work of the profession.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，用一个更好的词来说，可能是这个职业的苦差事。

sentences.en: That's how I used to think of it anyway.
sentences.zh: 我以前就是这么想的。

sentences.en: And that would be, you know, extra research,
sentences.zh: 那会是，你知道，额外的研究，

sentences.en: some psychometric testing,
sentences.zh: 一些心理测量测试，

sentences.en: probably say note-taking, letters, these sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 可能说是做笔记、写信，这些事情。

sentences.en: At least that's what I used to think.
sentences.zh: 至少我以前是这么想的。

sentences.en: And then when getting into the profession, I have had multiple, maybe conflicting experiences.
sentences.zh: 然后进入这个行业后，我有过多种，也许是相互矛盾的经历。

sentences.en: And then talking to others, some have had much more pressure on them,
sentences.zh: 然后和别人交谈，有些人承受的压力要大得多，

sentences.en: essentially kind of doing half of the psychologist work, you know, quite a lot of, quite a lot of clinical facing work with clients that maybe have too much risk for them.
sentences.zh: 基本上相当于做了心理学家一半的工作，你知道，有很多很多与客户面对面的工作，这些客户可能对他们来说风险太大了。

sentences.en: Because I suppose I would expect an assistant to have clinical facing work, but be very, very managed and maintained in that work.
sentences.zh: 因为我想我会期望助理有面对客户的工作，但在工作中受到非常、非常好的管理和维护。

sentences.en: So I suppose my original understanding was just the extra bits that the psychologist can afford to get rid of.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我最初的理解只是心理学家可以负担得起摆脱的额外部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I guess I've always thought about it as allowing the full and optimal functioning and capabilities of a qualified clinical or forensic or, you know, occupational psychologist,
sentences.zh: 我想我一直认为它允许合格的临床、法医或，你知道，职业心理学家发挥充分和最佳的功能和能力，

sentences.en: whilst optimising their function without them having to do some of the stuff that doesn't necessarily need to be done by a qualified psychologist
sentences.zh: 同时优化他们的功能，而不必让他们做一些不一定需要由合格心理学家做的事情，

sentences.en: that could be done under supervision of a practitioner psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而这些事情可以在执业心理学家的监督下完成。

sentences.en: And let's not make this purely about clinical, but a practitioner HCP psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们不要只谈临床，而是谈执业 HCP 心理学家。

sentences.en: So for example, it's important that we make that distinction because actually I was an assistant clinical psychologist in a forensic service.
sentences.zh: 例如，做出这种区分很重要，因为实际上我曾在法医服务部门担任助理临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And primarily in my first service, I was supervised by a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在我的第一个服务部门，我主要由一名临床心理学家监督。

sentences.en: But in my second assistant post, still with me, I was supervised by a forensic psychologist and actually really valued the supervision
sentences.zh: 但在我的第二个助理职位上，仍然和我在一起，我由一名法医心理学家监督，实际上非常重视来自这两位执业心理学家的监督。

sentences.en: from both of those practitioner psychologists.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，我正在朝着临床博士的路线努力。

sentences.en: But it was very clear that I was working towards a clinical doctor route.
sentences.zh: 但监督应该让人感到被重视。

sentences.en: But the supervision should feel valued.
sentences.zh: 它应该让人感到适当。

sentences.en: It should feel appropriate.
sentences.zh: 它应该让人觉得它能让你作为心理学团队的初级成员茁壮成长。

sentences.en: It should feel like it allows you to thrive as a junior member of the psychology team.
sentences.zh: 我知道在录音之前，我们俩都对我们阅读的 ACP 指南非常感兴趣，该指南说，实际上，你心理学毕业和进入专业博士学位之间的东西不是一个培训角色。

sentences.en: And I know before we hit record, both of us were quite intrigued by the guidance that we read by ACP that said, actually, the stuff in between your psychology graduation
sentences.zh: 为什么这会引起你的共鸣，Luke？

sentences.en: and your getting on to professional doctorate is not a training role.
sentences.zh: 我知道它为什么引起我的共鸣，但为什么它对你引起了这么大的共鸣？

sentences.en: Why did that resonate with you, Luke?
sentences.zh: 我想把它写下来真的很奇怪，因为从逻辑上讲它是有道理的，

sentences.en: I know why it resonated with me, but why did that resonate with you so much?
sentences.zh: 但我们在这些角色中获得了如此多的额外经验，这些经验是心理学知情的，无论是直接的还是间接的。

sentences.en: I suppose it was really strange to see it written down because logically it makes sense,
sentences.zh: 直接的，我的意思是说通过监督等等。

sentences.en: but we are picking up so much extra experience in these roles that is psychologically informed, whether it is direct or indirect.
sentences.zh: 间接的，你学到的东西，也许是你自己的反思，

sentences.en: And by direct, I mean through supervision and so on.
sentences.zh: 反思性实践。

sentences.en: Indirect, the things you pick up, maybe your own reflection,
sentences.zh: 但我认为它对我来说真的很深刻，因为有，

sentences.en: reflective practice.
sentences.zh: 我自己也在尝试攻读博士学位，在申请方面简直是一场血战，这段时期是多么困难，每个人都在某种程度上相互竞争，

sentences.en: But I suppose it was really poignant to me because there is,
sentences.zh: 我们很多人之间有大量的经验，

sentences.en: I'm trying to get on the doctorate myself, there is such a bloodbath when it comes to applications and how difficult that period is and everyone's sort of competing
sentences.zh: 在纸面上，我想技术上是不计算的，

sentences.en: against each other.
sentences.zh: 这似乎对这个行业适得其反，因为心理学应该能够从鸟瞰的角度看待一切，并提出为什么，还有什么？

sentences.en: that we have these tons and tons of experience between many of us
sentences.zh: 而你唯一能继续问为什么的方法就是拥有有不同经验的专业人士。

sentences.en: that on paper, I suppose technically isn't counted,
sentences.zh: 我认为因为每个人都应该拥有培训所要求的根本基础知识，然后你自己的经验应该能够以不同的方式利用它，

sentences.en: which seems like it's counterproductive for the profession because psychology is supposed to be able to take a bird's eye view above everything and sort of ask why, what else?
sentences.zh: 并可能像一条创造性的途径。

sentences.en: And the only way you can keep asking why is if you have professionals that have different experiences.
sentences.zh: 所以看到它被写下来很令人惊讶，我想，

sentences.en: I think because everyone should have the fundamental foundational knowledge which the training would dictate and then your own experience should be able to take that
sentences.zh: 因为它似乎与申请过程脱节了。

sentences.en: in different ways and potentially like a creative avenue.
sentences.zh: 对于临床和法医，我也有一些朋友也在走法医路线。

sentences.en: So it was surprising to see it written down, I suppose,
sentences.zh: 在这个意义上似乎很相似。

sentences.en: because it seems like a disconnect with the application process.
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何处理这些被告知要反思并接受监督的经验呢？

sentences.en: For clinical and forensic, I have some friends who are on the forensic route as well.
sentences.zh: 对我来说很奇怪，很矛盾。

sentences.en: It seems quite similar in that sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，我希望它不会让人觉得是一种打击，说你不重要。

sentences.en: So what are we to do with this experience that we're told to be reflective of and take supervision with?
sentences.zh: 我并不一定那样读它，你所做的一切，这只是毫无意义的，好像它不重要。

sentences.en: It's quite strange to me, quite conflicting.
sentences.zh: 我几乎把它理解为你没有临床责任。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I hope it didn't feel like a kick in the teeth that kind of said you don't matter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你甚至没有作为实习生的责任。

sentences.en: I didn't necessarily read it that way and all the stuff you're doing, it's just pointless, like it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我作为一名合格的心理学家在我的新七级职位上第一次签字，我认为需要做更多的工作来帮助你真正开始思考那种临床责任。

sentences.en: I almost took it as you don't hold clinical responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但这又是另一回事了。

sentences.en: You know, you don't even hold that as a trainee.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: You know, I signed for the first time as a qualified psychologist in my new band seven post and I think there needs to be more done to help you really begin to
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: think about that clinical responsibility.
sentences.zh: 它应该被用作某种，不，这是我需要做的事情。

sentences.en: But that's a whole different podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 我需要接受培训。

sentences.en: No, that's a really good point.
sentences.zh: 我需要做 X、Y、Z。

sentences.en: Yeah, I suppose you are right.
sentences.zh: 我没把它当作一种打击。

sentences.en: It should be used as sort of, no, this is the sort of thing I need to be doing.
sentences.zh: 我有点明白。

sentences.en: I need to be training.
sentences.zh: 我有点明白，一旦我合格了，我所有的经验都会非常有帮助，而且它现在在我的生活中已经很有帮助了。

sentences.en: I need to be doing X, Y, Z.
sentences.zh: 但以这种格式看到它很奇怪。

sentences.en: I didn't think of it as a kick in the teeth.
sentences.zh: 但你提出了一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: I kind of see it.
sentences.zh: 它应该更多地用作我们的盾牌。

sentences.en: I kind of see it as once I am qualified, all my experience would be really helpful and it's already helpful in my life now.
sentences.zh: 它应该让人感到非常安全。

sentences.en: But it's just strange to see in that format.
sentences.zh: 它应该让人觉得是一个成长、学习、发展、反思、好奇、玩乐的机会。

sentences.en: But you make a really great point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你应该在你的心理学团队中玩得很开心。

sentences.en: It should be used more of a shield for us.
sentences.zh: 它应该让人感到是一个安全的地方，你可以做你自己，你可以因为做你自己而被重视。

sentences.en: It should feel so safe.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我在两个助理环境中的助理经历。

sentences.en: It should feel like an opportunity to grow, learn, develop, reflect, be curious, have fun as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我在第一个助理职位时确实在三个病房做过分职，这非常多样化。

sentences.en: You know, you should be having fun within your psychology teaMs.
sentences.zh: 但我的第二个职位只是在一个针对青少年犯罪人群的环境中。

sentences.en: It should hopefully feel like a safe place where you can be yourself and you can be valued as being yourself.
sentences.zh: 但两次我都觉得被团队非常重视。

sentences.en: And I have to say that my experience of being an assistant in both of my assistant settings.
sentences.zh: 我被邀请参加，你知道，团队的社交活动，包括心理学团队和病房团队。

sentences.en: So I did do a split post across three wards when I was in my first assistant post, which was very varied and very diverse.
sentences.zh: 感觉真的很不错。

sentences.en: But then my second one was just in one setting with youth offending population.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我昨天在 LinkedIn 上发了一篇关于实习生室或助理室的帖子，人们在会议上被介绍为这是我的助理，这是我的实习生。

sentences.en: But both times I felt really valued by the teaMs.
sentences.zh: 实际上，不，这是 Luke。

sentences.en: And I was invited on, you know, socials and stuff with the teams, both the psychology teams and the ward teaMs.
sentences.zh: Luke，他和我们一起工作，作为团队中的助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And it was really nice to feel.
sentences.zh: 太不一样了。

sentences.en: You know, I put a post out on my LinkedIn yesterday about the trainee room or the assistant room and people being introduced at meetings
